control_acceptance: Compare explicitly recorded November 2023 BJD_TDB to Astropy recomputation from JD_UTC for every original row. Require max discrepancy 0.5 s. Preserve original column; separation judgment remains diagnostic.
method: Use Astropy builtin barycentric projection plus UTC-to-TDB scale conversion with shipped IERS tables and no network, with the site approximation bounded at Earth radius/c. Compare against separately retrieved geometric geocenter vectors from JPL Horizons in ICRF/TDB with allowance for topocentric light path.
use: Decide chronology of an already-declared false pairing. Neither reconstructed timestamps nor this historical diagnostic imply a newly detected transit, new independent photons, or any verified observing window.
